body.x: TCL Electronics (1070.HK), one of the most renowned companies in the television industry and a leader in the manufacture of electronic products worldwide, introduced its new Mini LED, QLED and 4K HDR TVs as part of its innovative AI x IoT strategy at CES 2021.

With a firm foot, TCL is taking the lead in the field of display technology at CES 2021. This year, it features three exceptional TVs with Mini LED, QLED and 4K HDR technology that go beyond powerful image quality and offer a wide range of modern features for new generations.
C825 - 4K Premium Mini LED Performance
The C825, TCL's latest Mini LED 4K TV, takes our TV and video game standards to the next level. The C825 is an important addition given TCL's ongoing commitment to Mini LED display technology.

The C825 adopts direct backlight mode, which reduces the grain size of traditional LEDs to 100'200'm. Thousands of light control units are used to increase the number of backlight sources. Combined with the full matrix system, an ultra-high directed regional brightness adjustment is achieved for a better visual experience.
With Quantum Dot display technology, the C825 combines light and color, a higher range and more precise light control for the best image quality effect.

The C825 also features Dolby Vision HDR image processing technology, which delivers an ultra-vivid image that adds realism to entertainment, and Dolby Vision IQ, which leverages all the intelligence of the C825 to deliver a perfect image in your room at any time of the day, and dynamically adjusts to changing environment light and the types of content that play , while maximizing all TV functions.
With superior audiovisual quality in addition to Imax Enhanced, the C825 offers unsused delight for home uses.
To make moving images smoother and video games more engaging, the C825 uses 120 Hz MEMC technology and a low 120 Hz reverse display.

In addition, a 4-connection HDMI 2.1 port, VRR, ALLM, eARC, WiFi6 and its low input latency give fans of faster, smoother graphics video games, as well as better sound effects. A 4-megapixel split-screen magnetic camera delivers superb visual and sound interactions for a superior video calling experience.
C725 - QLED 4K Superior Entertainment Center

Taking Quantum Dot display technology to a new level, the TCL C725 QLED 4K offers excellent value for money for those who want high-quality, interactive home entertainment as part of a connected and intelligent lifestyle.

With an ultra-high color gamut of nearly 100% (DCI-P3), the C725's Quantum Dot display technology delivers even brighter, more diverse colors without the limitations of lower color volume or shorter lifespan displayed by other color technologies.

Dolby Vision's ultra-vivid image and Dolby Atmos surround audio, along with Onkyo, offer an audiovisual feast. The C725's AiPQ Engine powers on the full potential of TCL's large-screen TVs with real-time optimization for different genres of entertainment or content.

Users can enjoy Hands-Free Voice Control 2.0, Google Duo and unlimited content from Netflix, Amazon Prime Video, Google play & Movie and Disney+, among others, so you can enjoy a smart life even more.
In addition, the C725 supports MEMC and HDMI 2.1, allowing you to deliver consistent images, even in fast action scenes.
P725 4K HDR TV with Dolby experience
The TCL P725 is a 4K HDR TV with Dolby Vision and Dolby Atmos, offering an impressive, high-quality, detailed experience, especially in dynamic motion images and surround audio.

Dolby Vision is an advanced imaging technology that combines high dynamic range (HDR) with wide color gamut capabilities to deliver ultra-vivid image quality with incredible brightness, contrast, color, and detail.
Surprisingly smooth motion image processing with MEMC technology ensures sharper, blur-free, stable image performance in fast, action-packed scenes.

The P725 also supports Dolby Atmos, which immerses you in your favorite entertainment with immersive sound of stunning realism, and offers incredible clarity and nuances that let you hear details you've never noticed before.

The P725 TCL's 2.0 hands-free voice control allows you to bypass the remote control. Switch channels, set reminders, and explore data transmission services using simple voice commands. The P725 also offers an enhanced entertainment experience with the latest on Android TV OS. Its millimeter metal edge design conveys a more spacious feel for entertainment.
